_help: Owner-editable exam sessions. Shown on the homepage board and the Availability page. Set live=true ONLY when you are keeping these rows accurate — that switches the site's 'Sample' label to 'Updated <date>'. Allowed status values: open | filling | waitlist | full (or omit status). 'when' is free text (a time, a date, or a cadence like 'Daily seats'). Keep 5-6 rows max for the board. See OWNER-GUIDE.md.
